justification: Inspected jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/JimfsInputStream.java, jimfs/src/test/java/com/google/common/jimfs/JimfsInputStreamTest.java, and jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/JimfsFileSystemProvider.java. The class is small (163 lines) and narrowly scoped to InputStream behavior over a RegularFile: 6 stream overrides (read/read(byte[])/read(byte[],int,int)/skip/available/close), 1 constructor, and 4 tiny private helpers for EOF/closed-state handling. The tests exercise only stream semantics, and the provider instantiates it solely as the input-stream adapter, so there is no evidence of multiple separable responsibilities or under-decomposition.
